readme:
The manifest behind the options demo. Hand-written, because this repo documents an element that *reads* custom-elements.json and does not produce one — a real library generates this from JSDoc with @custom-elements-manifest/analyzer and ships it as its `customElements` key.

Everything the panel uses is here and nothing else: attributes with a type and a default, cssProperties with a syntax and a default, events with a description. `--demo-badge-size` deliberately has no default, so the panel falls back to what the frame computes for it. `--demo-badge-outline` defaults to `transparent`, which is the value no color picker can hold and the panel draws as a crossed-out square.

declarations.name: DemoBadge
declarations.description: A label with a count. Styled by sample.css and backed by no JavaScript at all — an unknown tag is still an element the page can style.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: A number after the label. Omitted entirely when unset.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Quieter than the text around it, or ringed to stand out.

cssProperties.name: --demo-badge-bg
cssProperties.description: The pill's fill. A color-mix by default, which is why the control is a text field and not a color input.

cssProperties.name: --demo-badge-fg
cssProperties.description: The text color. `currentcolor` inherits whatever the page is set in.

cssProperties.name: --demo-badge-padding
cssProperties.description: Padding inside the pill, in the shorthand's own order.

cssProperties.name: --demo-badge-size
cssProperties.description: Font size. Documented without a default on purpose — the panel reads the frame's computed value instead.

cssProperties.name: --demo-badge-outline
cssProperties.description: A ring around the pill. `transparent` by default, which is the value a color picker cannot hold — hence the crossed-out swatch.

events.name: demo-badge-click
events.description: Fires when the badge is clicked. `detail.label` is what it says, `detail.badge` the element itself. Deliberately does not bubble — the panel listens in the capture phase, so it hears it anyway.
